Thwarting needs a member that acts toward its demand while the demand goes unmet. Putting [CLAIM-347](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md)'s requirement complex beside [CLAIM-549](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-549.md)'s quiescent complex shows that neither decides when frustration forces such a member. A third complex decides it: the sets that some attainable arrangement leaves each member met or quiet. The result is derived and checked exhaustively on small instances. It is a necessary condition of thwarting, not an identification of thwarting, which still needs the causal evidence [CLAIM-357](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-357.md) and [QUESTION-131](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-131.md) ask for.
